name: University of Fribourg
description: The University of Fribourg is a public university founded in 1889 and Switzerland's only bilingual university, teaching in French and German. It has five faculties including law, management and economics, and science and medicine.
whyIncluded: The University of Fribourg is among the 10 universities in Switzerland most chosen by international students (about 18% of its 6,838 students are international, per Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027 data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own approximate monthly budget for students in shared housing, using the middle of its ranges, for 12 months a year. Excludes health insurance and fees.
livingCosts.notes: unifr incoming-students budget page (monthly; midpoints): rental in shared accommodation 350-450 (400); food 450; transport TPF season pass 60; personal = phone/internet 100 + clothes/toiletries 100 + course materials/exam fees 150-250 (200) + recreation/culture 150-200 (175) = 575. Health/accident insurance 250-330 excluded. unifr's total CHF 1,600-1,900 a month without insurance. Page undated, read 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition at the rate for foreign students, plus the basic semester fee that covers sport, library and the student association. A one-off CHF 100 application fee is extra.
programmes.notes: University of Fribourg 'University fees' page: foreign students CHF 115 basic registration + CHF 870 tuition = CHF 985 per semester (Swiss CHF 720 tuition); tuition 870 x 2 = 1,740; basic fee 115 x 2 = 230 (general costs 28, library 12, AGEF student association 20, Uni-Social fund 30, sports 15, copyright 5, campus card 5). One-off: CHF 100 non-refundable application fee for holders of foreign diplomas (unifr admission pages for bachelor and master with foreign qualifications; +CHF 50 for late applications, excluded). Fee history: cantonal Ordonnance concernant la taxe d'inscription (RSF 431.0.16, adopted 7 Nov 2017), art. 3: CHF 870 per semester for foreign students; unifr's 2018 factsheet shows 870 from autumn 2018 and the version in force since 15 Nov 2024 still says 870, so 2024-25 and 2025-26 tuition was CHF 1,740. The basic fee is set by the Rectorate and was also CHF 115 in 2018, but no 2024/2025 figure was found, so history rows carry tuition only. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor, taught in French and German (bilingual option).
